en.headline: Tai Po water main burst leaves thousands without supply overnight
en.dek: A 200-millimetre fresh-water pipe burst on On Po Road near Tai Yuen Estate; the Water Supplies Department will shut off supply after 11 p.m. for repairs and aims to restore service by noon on Thursday.
body: A fresh-water main burst on On Po Road near Tai Yuen Estate in Tai Po on Wednesday afternoon, sending large volumes of water onto the road and disrupting supply to Tai Yuen Estate, Ting Nga Court, Tai Po Plaza and nearby blocks. About 5,000 households were expected to be affected.

The Water Supplies Department said it would suspend supply after the evening peak, from about 11 p.m., to allow emergency repairs. Temporary water tankers and water tanks were deployed, and bottled water was being delivered to elderly homes and residents in need.

The department said it aimed to complete the emergency works and restore supply by noon on Thursday unless unexpected difficulties, including adverse weather, arose. It was coordinating with the Tai Po District Office, the Housing Department, district councillors and estate management offices to support affected residents.

zh.headline: 大埔安埔路食水管爆裂 大元邨汀雅苑等近五千戶受影響
zh.dek: 水務署安排今晚11時後停水維修，爭取明日中午12時前恢復供水，並已派出水車及水箱提供臨時食水。
body: 大埔安埔路近大元邨星期三下午一條直徑200毫米的食水管爆裂，大量食水湧出路面，影響大元邨、汀雅苑、大埔廣場及附近大廈的食水供應，預料近五千戶受影響。
水務署表示，為減低對居民影響，將於今晚11時用水高峰期後停水進行緊急維修，並已安排水車及水箱放置於受影響範圍，亦派出供水特攻隊為有需要用戶及安老院送上樽裝水。
署方爭取於星期四中午12時前完成緊急維修並恢復食水供應，除非遇上特別工程困難或惡劣天氣。水務署已與大埔民政處、房屋署、區議員及屋苑管理處緊密聯繫，為有需要市民提供支援。
